findings.summary: nextClaudeInstruction from gatekeeper model flows into pathsNamedIn without untrusted-source labelling; path extraction regex matches all tokens regardless of narrative context — the approved-maximum gate is the real defense but the design trusts model output more than strictly necessary at this step
Duplicate JSDoc block on degradedContinuation in runner.ts lines 469-485; first block contradicts the second and the code — delete the superseded block

readCommittedGrant uses HEAD:<rel> without ./ prefix in degradedModeGrants.ts line 121, while committedGovernanceOwner in the same file documents that HEAD:./<rel> is required for sub-directory checkouts — one-character fix

unreadableDegradedStores in degradedMode.ts reads directly from disk via parseStore(sys.readText(...)) while readAllDegradedStores routes through readDegradedStoreDetailed which reads from git for committed files — inconsistent read paths, denial-of-self only

safeExcerpt in openaiResponses.ts filters control chars but passes Unicode bidirectional overrides (U+202E etc) and zero-width characters that could visually obscure content in operator-facing log output
store:true in OpenAI Responses API body persists evidence content (check output up to 4000 chars, findings, effects) on OpenAI servers unconditionally — no opt-out mechanism per call

consumeDegradedGrant at degradedMode.ts line 489 uses lenient readDegradedStore (returns null on corrupt) for read-back before appending work item — corrupt store resets ordinal to 1, potentially causing colliding ordinal that defeats exhaustion check
correctionMaximumPaths is caller-supplied in RunOptions with no committed-plan verification inside runLoop — if CLI derives from working-tree plan rather than committed plan, boundary is wrong
appendLedger in gatekeeperConfig.ts uses cmd /c move for atomic rename — Windows-only, silent failure on other platforms; project is currently Windows-only but System abstraction is portable

pathsNamedIn extension whitelist (.ts .tsx .js .cjs .mjs .json .md) in correctionBoundary.ts is invisible at call sites in runner.ts — a .yaml correction instruction would be refused with misleading 'no path named' message
pathsNamedIn regex only matches forward-slash paths; Windows backslash paths in gatekeeper instructions would fail to extract, causing unnecessary correction refusal (fails closed, safe)
Budget estimate uses fixed 800-token output assumption in gatekeeperTurn.ts line 281; actual response may exceed estimate — per-call enforcement is approximate though monthly ledger uses actuals
